answer: Sybil names stay cheap unless each agent keeps one exclusive duty at a harbor range light. An applicant bonds 37 coins for 22 days on lamp platform P-8 and hangs a one-use enamel disc whose serial and a short fable, hashed at intake, face the tide staff. At the third flood a clerk photographs the disc beside the official 1.7 m mark and files the still. Peers attest only if the harbor registry lists that serial once, the fable hash matches intake, and the mark sits within 4 cm of the published tide. A reused disc or two names on one platform burns the bond and darkens that lamp for 17 months.
